about_the_game:
Welcome to Topworld, an adventure in a world full of possibilities. Step into a fantasy medieval realm where you can build your own village and explore a magical forest.

Solve puzzles scattered across the world as you experiment, explore, and discover secrets. Use your mage abilities—teleportation, shockwaves, remote-controlled projectiles, and even magical fishing—to navigate and enjoy the world around you.

Beyond exploration, there’s a mysterious ancient temple waiting to be completed. Gather resources, reveal its secrets, and bring the temple back to life as part of your journey.

Build homes, lay paths, decorate with furniture, and shape rivers, lakes, forests, and gardens to make your village and surroundings truly your own. Along the way, you’ll encounter surprises that make every adventure unique.

All of this comes alive in charming pixel art, making Topworld a world that’s inviting to explore. Build, solve, and adventure—your journey in Topworld awaits.

Features:

  • Build and expand your own village

  • Explore a world full of puzzles, secrets, and surprises

  • Craft buildings, decorations, weapons, and more

  • Fantasy medieval setting

  • Face enemies as you explore the world

  • Unique magical abilities

  • Complete an ancient temple

  • Terraform rivers, lakes, and landscapes

  • Design forests, gardens, and plant life

  • Cute pixel art style that invites dreaming
